facts.summary: Love had no on-field work during the Aug. 24 practice week after a high-ankle sprain; Arizona still hoped for a Week 1 return, with Tyler Allgeier positioned to lead if Love sits.

outlook.summary: Athlon considers a normal opening-week workload difficult to project and calls the risk substantial at Love's draft cost.

facts.summary: Henderson avoided a serious right-ankle injury and was expected to be available for Week 1, though he missed the preseason finale.

outlook.summary: No substantial draft downgrade, but Athlon notes Rhamondre Stevenson could open the season with the larger backfield share.

facts.summary: Hubbard remained out of contact work while rehabbing a hamstring, though Carolina said he was on schedule for Week 1; Jonathon Brooks had strengthened his committee case.

outlook.summary: Athlon recommends drafting Hubbard with a shared workload in mind even if cleared for the opener.

facts.summary: Conner had not reached 11-on-11 work during recovery from foot surgery, and Arizona said it was too early to know whether he would play Week 1; Tyler Allgeier was the healthy top-group back at the time.

outlook.summary: Opening-week availability and workload are uncertain.

facts.summary: Athlon said Allgeier would lead Arizona's backfield if Jeremiyah Love missed time.
At the same update, James Conner had not reached 11-on-11 work and Love remained sidelined, leaving Allgeier as the healthy member of Arizona's projected top group.

outlook.summary: The injuries ahead of him create meaningful near-term workload upside for Allgeier if either Love or Conner is unavailable or limited.

facts.summary: TreVeyon Henderson missed the preseason finale after an ankle injury, though he was expected back for Week 1.

outlook.summary: Athlon says Henderson's interruption could help Stevenson open the season with the larger backfield share.

facts.summary: Chuba Hubbard was still out of contact work while rehabbing a hamstring when Athlon reported that Brooks had strengthened his case for a committee role.

outlook.summary: Brooks' committee case improves while Hubbard works back, adding short-term role upside without guaranteeing a lead-back workload.
